meta.notes: Callout and hourly figures are market anchors gathered from public Brisbane cost guides (hipages plumbing guide Jul 2026, Connex Electrical published Brisbane price list Nov 2026, Supertrades handyman calculator 2026). Archetype totals are derived from those anchors by hour count, rounded to the trade's typical quoting step. Tiers: low = book ahead, medium = within 24h, high = same day / after hours.

jobs.scenario: Burst pipe under the kitchen sink
jobs.description: Water is spraying out from under the kitchen sink, I have turned the tap off under there but there is water all over the floorboards

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: New Farm

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: ASAP, it is leaking right now

answers.prompt: What have you already turned off or unplugged?
answers.answer: The little tap under the sink. Water is still dripping but not spraying

answers.prompt: Is the water near any power points or wiring?
answers.answer: There is a power point right beside the cupboard, I turned that one off at the wall

writeUp.title: Burst flexi hose under the kitchen sink
writeUp.summary: A braided flexi hose under the kitchen sink has split and was spraying water. The customer has shut off the isolation valve and the nearby power point. Floorboards are wet and the cabinet base is soaked.

details.label: Damage
details.value: Floorboards and cabinet base wet, no visible ceiling damage

details.label: Power
details.value: Nearby power point switched off at the wall

writeUp.priceReason: Emergency same-day callout with the parts commonly needed for a split flexi hose.

jobs.scenario: Half the kitchen power points are dead
jobs.description: None of the power points along the kitchen bench are working and one of them made a popping noise earlier. The rest of the house is fine

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Teneriffe

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: Today if possible, we cannot use the kettle or microwave

answers.prompt: Has a safety switch or breaker tripped?
answers.answer: One switch in the box was down, I put it back up and it did not trip again

answers.prompt: Did you see or smell anything when it happened?
answers.answer: Heard a pop from the power point next to the microwave, no smoke or smell now

writeUp.title: Kitchen power point circuit fault after a pop
writeUp.summary: Four power points on the kitchen bench circuit are dead. The customer heard a pop from the point beside the microwave and reset a tripped breaker once. There is no smoke or burning smell now, but a damaged point or loose termination is likely and should be isolated before the circuit is used again.

details.label: Breaker
details.value: Tripped once, reset by customer, not retripping

details.label: Symptom
details.value: Audible pop at one power point

details.label: Appliance
details.value: Microwave was running at the time

writeUp.priceReason: Fault finding on an unknown circuit, with the isolation and replacement of a damaged power point allowed for.

jobs.scenario: Water stain spreading on the ceiling after rain
jobs.description: There is a brown stain on the lounge room ceiling that has got bigger after the storms this week, and it feels soft when I press it

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Bulimba

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: Before the next rain, so this week

answers.prompt: Is water coming through right now?
answers.answer: No dripping at the moment, it only shows up when it rains hard

answers.prompt: What is above that ceiling?
answers.answer: Single storey, tiled roof, that room is under the ridge line

writeUp.title: Roof leak staining the lounge ceiling
writeUp.summary: A ceiling stain about the size of a dinner plate has grown after recent storms and the plasterboard is soft to touch, which means it has been wet more than once. The roof above is tiled and the room sits under the ridge line, so ridge capping or flashing is the likely entry point.

details.label: Ceiling condition
details.value: Soft when pressed, needs inspection from above

writeUp.priceReason: Roof inspection and leak repair on a tiled roof, priced for a same-week visit.

writeUp.title: Locked out of the house, deadlocked front door

details.label: Door

details.label: Keys
details.value: Visible inside, not in the lock
